title: This 0DTE SPX Strategy Targets 1200% Average Wins
summary: Shamoun Bari (addressed on air as 'Jamal') pitches a convex 0DTE SPX long call butterfly: buy a very narrow (5-15 pt, usually 10) ATM call fly around 2:15pm ET on a predicted closing 'pin' derived from dealer-gamma profiles + RSI divergence + DSS Bressert + VWAP, scale in 1-3 contracts on the same strike, then scale out into the close (close half at +300-500%, leave ~10% to expiry). Defined risk (max loss = ~$40-55 debit), sized 0.5-1% of portfolio. Headline claims: 52% win rate, 1200% average winner (median ~750%, max 4000-5000%), 52%/yr return, one setup every 2-4 weeks. Skeptic read: the 1200% avg win is the trap and is almost certainly OptionStrat theoretical-peak P&L, not realized scaled-out fills; the claimed inputs imply an implausible +520%/risk EV; no separable track record (only a winning OptionStrat example), the win-making step is admitted discretionary last-30-min management, and the tiny ~13-26 trades/yr sample is statistical noise. Defined risk is the one real virtue. Write-up: strategies/zerodte_convex_butterfly.md (conviction 1.5/5).
